title: Item
description: An object — mundane or otherwise. Includes equipment, artifacts, foci candidates.

properties.description: Notable properties or affordances. E.g. 'concealable', 'fragile', 'requires power', 'illegal'.

focusDomain.description: If this item can serve as a focus, which domain it resonates with. Items don't have to be foci; this field is left absent for ordinary objects.

carriedBy.description: Who currently has this. Reference by name or id.

origin.description: Where this came from. Free text.

value.description: Approximate worth, in narrative rather than numeric terms. 'pocket change', 'a month's rent', 'inheritance-tier'.
